mapper.select: select * from Board order by idx desc offset #{offset} rows fetch next #{limit} rows only
mapper.insert: insert into Board(idx, title, writer, content, img) values( idx_seq.nextval, #{title}, #{writer}, #{content}, #{img, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: select * from Board where title like '%' || #{search} || '%' or writer like '%' || #{search} || '%' or content like '%' || #{search} || '%'
mapper.update: update Board set title = #{title}, writer = #{writer}, content = #{content}, img = #{img, jdbcType=VARCHAR} where idx = #{idx}
